frozen_candidate_root_contribution: A previously-possessed content (a fact, obligation, sign, person, or self) CEASING to be actively held / kept-present in an agent's mind-or-regard — the lapse of retention, whereby something that was once held drops out of the holder's active grasp. The root always presupposes prior possession/knowledge of the item and marks its falling-out-of-hold; it does not merely mean "not-attending" (which need not presuppose prior possession) nor "leaving" a physical location.

internal_discovery.candidate_root_contribution: A previously-possessed content (a fact, obligation, sign, person, or self) CEASING to be actively held / kept-present in an agent's mind-or-regard — the lapse of retention, whereby something that was once held drops out of the holder's active grasp. The root always presupposes prior possession/knowledge of the item and marks its falling-out-of-hold; it does not merely mean "not-attending" (which need not presuppose prior possession) nor "leaving" a physical location.
internal_discovery.plain_explanation: Across every form-family the invariant is a content dropping out of an agent's active mental/relational hold. (1) Plain retention-lapse, form I: "نَسِيَا حُوتَهُمَا" they forgot their fish (18:61), "نَسِيتُ ٱلْحُوتَ" I forgot the fish (18:63:8), Moses "بِمَا نَسِيتُ" what I forgot (18:73), "إِذَا نَسِيتَ" when you forget (18:24), "إِن نَّسِينَآ" if we forget (2:286), and the promise "سَنُقْرِئُكَ فَلَا تَنسَىٰٓ" We shall make you recite, so you will not forget (87:6) — here the object is a possessed content (the fish they had, the given recitation) that lapses or is guaranteed not to lapse. (2) Culpable dropping of a known obligation/sign, still form I: "نَسِىَ مَا قَدَّمَتْ يَدَاهُ" forgot what his hands sent forth (18:57), "نَسُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ" they forgot God (9:67, 59:19), "نَسُوا۟ ٱلذِّكْرَ" forgot the reminder (25:18), "نَسِيتُمْ لِقَآءَ يَوْمِكُمْ" you forgot the meeting of this Day (32:14, 45:34, 7:51), "وَلَا تَنسَ نَصِيبَكَ" do not forget your portion (28:77), "وَلَا تَنسَوُا۟ ٱلْفَضْلَ" do not forget the graciousness between you (2:237), "نَسِىَ خَلْقَهُۥ" forgot his own creation (36:78) — the residue is identical (a held item drops from active regard); context/participants add moral culpability. (3) Divine requital: "ٱلْيَوْمَ نَنسَىٰكُمْ كَمَا نَسِيتُمْ" today We forget you as you forgot (45:34; cf. 7:51 نَنسَىٰهُمْ, 32:14 نَسِينَٰكُمْ, 9:67 فَنَسِيَهُمْ) — God's "forgetting" = ceasing to keep them in beneficent regard, explicitly mirrored on their own nsy by "كَمَا نَسِيتُمْ". (4) Form IV causative (V(IV)): "فَأَنسَىٰهُ ٱلشَّيْطَٰنُ ذِكْرَ رَبِّهِۦ" Satan made him drop remembrance (12:42), "أَنسَىٰنِيهُ إِلَّا ٱلشَّيْطَٰنُ" none made me forget it but Satan (18:63:11), "أَنسَوْكُمْ ذِكْرِى" made you forget My remembrance (23:110), "فَأَنسَىٰهُمْ ذِكْرَ ٱللَّهِ / أَنفُسَهُمْ" (58:19, 59:19), "يُنسِيَنَّكَ ٱلشَّيْطَٰنُ" (6:68), and abrogation "أَوْ نُنسِهَا" or cause it to be forgotten (2:106) — causer makes a content drop from another's hold. (5) Nominal: "كُنتُ نَسْيًا مَّنسِيًّا" a forgotten thing utterly forgotten (19:23), i.e. the very content that has dropped out; and negated of God "وَمَا كَانَ رَبُّكَ نَسِيًّا" your Lord is never forgetful (19:64), "لَا يَضِلُّ رَبِّى وَلَا يَنسَى" (20:52) — the faculty of dropping-from-hold, denied of God. Every occurrence recovers the same core: something once held ceases to be held.
internal_discovery.layer_separation_note: FORM: Form I (V, نَسِيَ) = the agent's own content drops from hold; Form IV (V(IV), أَنسَى/نُنسِ) = causative, an external causer (Satan, God) makes a content drop from another's hold; verbal noun نَسْي = the dropped-out thing itself (19:23); adjectival نَسِيّ = disposed-to-dropping/forgetful (19:64). Subtracting form leaves the same relation (content ↔ hold), only the voice/valency differs. CONSTRUCTION: mostly direct transitive (object = the lapsed content: fish, signs, God, self, portion); the object supplies WHAT is dropped, not the dropping itself. PARTICIPANTS: humans as forgetters; Satan/God as causers (Form IV) or as talionic "forgetter" (God, 7:51/9:67/32:14/45:34); God as negated subject (19:64, 20:52). The deliberate-abandonment coloring of the divine cases comes entirely from the participant (God, who "does not forget") plus mirroring context, NOT from the root. CONTEXT: narrative (fish, Adam 20:115, Samiri 20:88), moral (forgot God/reminder), eschatological (mutual forgetting at the Day), legal/oath (2:237, 2:286). After subtracting all four layers the non-empty residue is the bare lapse-of-holding.
internal_discovery.strongest_counterexample: The divine requital cases — "ٱلْيَوْمَ نَنسَىٰكُمْ" We forget you today (7:51:10, 45:34:3), "إِنَّا نَسِينَٰكُمْ" (32:14:8), "فَنَسِيَهُمْ" so He forgot them (9:67:15) — are hardest, because the same corpus flatly denies that God forgets: "وَمَا كَانَ رَبُّكَ نَسِيًّا" (19:64) and "لَا يَضِلُّ رَبِّى وَلَا يَنسَى" (20:52). If nsy meant strictly "memory failure," these would be a direct internal contradiction. They reconcile through an internally-attested bridge: each divine "forget" is stamped with "كَمَا نَسِيتُمْ / كَمَا نَسُوا۟" (as you forgot), marking a deliberate talionic mirroring — God ceases to keep them in active beneficent regard exactly as they let Him drop from theirs. The residue "content ceasing to be kept in active hold/regard" survives; only the accidental-vs-deliberate parameter flips, and that flip is supplied by the participant (God) and the explicit mirroring, not by the root. Thus no true contradiction; it is a reconciled extension.
internal_discovery.competing_hypothesis: Strongest alternative: the core is "to neglect / abandon / leave-off (tark)" rather than "lapse of retention." This fits the culpable and divine cases well ("forgot God" = abandoned Him; "We forget you" = We abandon you). Internal evidence arbitrates AGAINST making neglect the core and FOR retention-lapse as basic: (a) "نَسِيَا حُوتَهُمَا" (18:61) and "نَسِيتُ ٱلْحُوتَ ... أَنسَىٰنِيهُ ٱلشَّيْطَٰنُ" (18:63) are pure involuntary memory-loss of a physical object, not willful abandonment; (b) "سَنُقْرِئُكَ فَلَا تَنسَىٰٓ" (87:6) promises retention of recitation — "you will not abandon" is nonsensical, "you will not lose from memory" is exact; (c) the Form IV causer "أَنسَىٰهُ ٱلشَّيْطَٰنُ" (12:42, 6:68) causes a lapse of remembrance, not causes an abandonment. Hence "neglect/abandon" is a contextual extension (present only where the object is an obligation and the subject is culpable, or the requiter is God), whereas retention-lapse is recoverable everywhere. The proposed neutral residue "ceasing to keep in active hold/regard" subsumes both poles.
internal_discovery.distinctiveness_note: Nearest neighbors: (1) غ ف ل ghfl "heedlessness/inattention" — the closest. Distinction: ghafla is a state of NOT-attending that need not presuppose prior possession of the content; nsy always presupposes a content once held/known that then drops out (the covenant made, the signs delivered, the fish had, the recitation given). Falsifiability: if nsy were ever applied to a content the agent never possessed/knew, the retention-lapse residue would collapse into mere ghafla — but no occurrence does this. (2) ت ر ك trk "to leave/abandon deliberately" — implies a chosen setting-aside without any mental-hold component; nsy specifically concerns the drop from mind/regard (why the divine talionic cases still say nsy, not trk, keying off the humans' mental lapse). (3) ذ ك ر *kr "remember/keep-mentioning" and ح ف ظ Hfz "guard/retain" are the positive antonyms; nsy is their negative pole, confirmed by constant co-text ("ذِكْرَ رَبِّهِ", "مَا ذُكِّرُوا۟ بِهِ", "وَٱذْكُر رَّبَّكَ إِذَا نَسِيتَ" 18:24 pairing dhikr against nsy). (4) ض ل ل Dll "go astray/err" — loss of way/direction, distinct from loss-from-hold.
internal_discovery.rationale: A single non-empty residue — a once-held content ceasing to be actively held/kept-present in mind-or-regard — is recoverable in all 45 occurrences with a determinate direction (from held to dropped-out). It is surface-transparent in the retention-lapse cluster (fish 18:61/18:63; when-you-forget 18:24; you-will-not-forget 87:6; if-we-forget 2:286), in the causative Form IV cluster (Satan/God making a content drop, 12:42/18:63/23:110/58:19/59:19/6:68/2:106), and in the nominals (19:23 the dropped thing; 19:64 & 20:52 the faculty denied of God). The reason this is MODERATE rather than STRONG is twofold: (a) the divine talionic cases (7:51, 9:67, 32:14, 45:34) require a metaphorical-extension inference from "memory-lapse" to "deliberate withdrawal of regard" — reconciled, and internally bridged by the explicit "كَمَا نَسِيتُمْ" mirroring plus the flat denial that God literally forgets (19:64, 20:52), but still an inference layer; and (b) the nearest neighbor غفل (heedlessness) is genuinely close, so distinctiveness rests on the "prior-possession presupposition" rather than on a sharp surface contrast. No occurrence is left unreconciled, so inconsistent_refs is empty and the disposition is PREFERRED; the extension inference and the near-neighbor proximity hold the strength at MODERATE rather than STRONG.

adversarial_verification.notes:
REFUTATION ATTEMPT (all 45 accounted for). I pressed four attack vectors and none broke the candidate.

(1) DIVINE-REQUITAL cases — 45:34:3 (نَنسَىٰكُمْ), 7:51:10 (نَنسَىٰهُمْ), 32:14:8 (نَسِينَٰكُمْ), 9:67:15 (فَنَسِيَهُمْ). God cannot literally suffer a retention-lapse (explicitly denied: 19:64 نَسِيًّا, 20:52 لَا يَنسَى), so these must be metaphor. Attack: is this really nsy, or is it abandonment (→ ترك)? Resolution: the text itself defines it as the SAME root applied by mirror — كَمَا نَسِيتُمْ / كَمَا نَسُوا۟ — so the divine act is explicitly measured against human nsy. It resolves cleanly on the candidate's "regard" branch (ceasing to keep them in active beneficent regard). Not ad hoc: the disjunction is textually forced, not invented to patch.

(2) NEGATIVE IMPERATIVES — hardest cases: 28:77 (وَلَا تَنسَ نَصِيبَكَ) and 2:237 (وَلَا تَنسَوُا۟ ٱلْفَضْلَ). These lean toward "do not neglect," which flirts with غفل (inattention). Attack: is prior possession really present, or is this pure not-attending? Resolution: the objects are KNOWN assigned contents — one's allotted نصيب of the dunya and the standing norm of فَضْل between parties — so the "prior knowledge/possession" discriminator holds, and the imperative rides the "kept-present" (regard) side of the invariant. Borderline but saveable without circularity. cf. 2:44 (تَنسَوْنَ أَنفُسَكُمْ) and 59:19 (أَنفُسَهُمْ) — the self is always "possessed," so ceasing to keep it in active regard fits directly.

(3) FORM IV causatives — 12:42, 18:63:11, 23:110, 58:19, 59:19:6, 6:68, 2:106 (نُنسِهَا). All are "a causer makes a possessed/known content drop from another's hold." 2:106 could be read from نسأ (postpone), but under the given nsy assignment it is cause-to-forget an existing āyah — fits. No failure.

(4) NOMINALS — 19:23 (نَسْيًا مَّنسِيًّا) is the dropped-content itself; 19:64/20:52 deny the drop-faculty of God. Fit.

DISTINCTIVENESS (ok=true): The candidate discriminates sharply. vs غفل: nsy PRESUPPOSES prior possession/knowledge; غفل need not. vs ترك: nsy is mental/relational hold, not physical departure. vs ضلّ: decisive — 20:52 pairs them as distinct (لَا يَضِلُّ رَبِّى وَلَا يَنسَىٰ), the text itself separating "mislay/err" from "let-drop-from-hold." The plain-retention set (fish 18:61/18:63:8, recitation 87:6, 18:24, 2:286, 18:73) and the culpable-obligation set (9:67/59:19 نَسُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ, 25:18, 32:14, 36:78, 5:13/5:14 حَظًّا, 6:44/7:165 مَا ذُكِّرُوا۟) recover an identical residue; culpability is supplied by participants/context, not by the root.

FALSIFIABILITY (true): Clear failure condition — an occurrence with NO prior possession/knowledge of the item, or meaning bare physical leaving, or pure inattention. None meets it. The two negative imperatives are the nearest approach and were reconciled via known-content readings, not by dissolving the discriminator.

CONCLUSION: The only internal variation (literal forgetting vs. God's metaphorical "forgetting") is bridged by the Quran's own explicit mirroring, so there is no genuine semantic split or homonymy to exploit. The "mind-or-regard" disjunction reflects the actual attested range of the root rather than over-fitting. I could not manufacture a genuine failing occurrence. Verdict SUPPORTED.

occurrence_dispositions.note: فَأَنسَىٰهُ ٱلشَّيْطَٰنُ ذِكْرَ رَبِّهِ: causative — Satan makes the remembrance (previously held) drop from the man's active hold. Residue present.
إِذَا نَسِيتَ: plain form-I retention-lapse of something one held; command to remember God upon the lapse. Residue present.
نَسِىَ مَا قَدَّمَتْ يَدَاهُ: a known deed/consequence drops from active regard; context adds culpability but residue is intact.
نَسِيَا حُوتَهُمَا: the fish they possessed falls out of their active hold — paradigmatic retention-lapse.
أَنسَىٰنِيهُ إِلَّا ٱلشَّيْطَٰنُ: causative — none but Satan made the held content (the fish/its mention) drop from my grasp.
نَسِيتُ ٱلْحُوتَ: I forgot the fish — the possessed item lapses from active hold. Residue present.
بِمَا نَسِيتُ: Moses asks not to be blamed for what he forgot — a held commitment/knowledge dropped from grasp.
نَسْيًا (nominal): the very thing dropped-out-of-hold, a discarded/forgotten thing. Residue = the content that has fallen from regard.
مَّنسِيًّا: passive participle — utterly dropped from others' regard/hold. Residue present.
وَمَا كَانَ رَبُّكَ نَسِيًّا: the faculty of letting content drop from hold, explicitly denied of God. Residue coherently negated.
فَنَسِىَ (Adam): the prior covenant (عَهِدْنَآ) drops from his active hold — presupposed prior possession, retention-lapse.
فَنَسِيتَهَا: you dropped Our signs from active regard after they came to you — held content lapses; culpable.
ٱلْيَوْمَ تُنسَىٰ: passive requital — today you are dropped from (beneficent) regard, mirroring فَنَسِيتَهَا. Bridged by candidate's own regard-lapse logic.
وَلَا يَنسَى: God does not let anything drop from His hold/record (فِى كِتَٰبٍ). Residue coherently negated.
فَنَسِىَ: something once held (Moses' god / the true object) is claimed to have dropped from hold. Residue present regardless of disputed referent.
أَنسَوْكُمْ ذِكْرِى: causative — the mockers made My remembrance drop from your active hold.
نَسُوا۟ ٱلذِّكْرَ: the reminder they had received drops from active regard after being indulged. Residue present.
وَلَا تَنسَ نَصِيبَكَ: do not let your (held) portion of the world drop from active regard — metaphorical neglect bridged by held-item-drops logic.
أَوْ نُنسِهَا: causative (abrogation) — a previously-given verse is caused to drop from hold. Residue present.
وَلَا تَنسَوُا۟ ٱلْفَضْلَ بَيْنَكُمْ: do not let mutual graciousness drop from active regard — held disposition; bridged.
إِن نَّسِينَآ: if we let a known obligation drop from active hold — plea against blame for retention-lapse. Residue present.
وَتَنسَوْنَ أَنفُسَكُمْ: you let your own selves drop from active regard while enjoining others — self as possessed content lapsing. Residue present.
بِمَا نَسِيتُمْ لِقَآءَ يَوْمِكُمْ: the (foretold, held) meeting of the Day dropped from active regard. Residue present.
إِنَّا نَسِينَٰكُمْ: divine requital — We drop you from beneficent regard, mirroring their own نَسِيتُمْ. Bridged.
وَنَسِىَ خَلْقَهُ: he let the fact of his own creation drop from active regard. Residue present.
بِمَا نَسُوا۟ يَوْمَ ٱلْحِسَابِ: they let the (known) Day of Reckoning drop from active regard. Residue present.
نَسِىَ مَا كَانَ يَدْعُوٓا۟ إِلَيْهِ: he drops from hold the very One he had been praying to — presupposed prior relation lapsing.
ٱلْيَوْمَ نَنسَىٰكُمْ: divine requital — ceasing to keep them in beneficent regard, explicitly mirrored by كَمَا نَسِيتُمْ. Bridged.
كَمَا نَسِيتُمْ لِقَآءَ يَوْمِكُمْ: their own retention-lapse of the held meeting — the referent of the mirror. Residue present.
فَأَنسَىٰهُمْ ذِكْرَ ٱللَّهِ: causative — Satan makes God's remembrance drop from their hold.
وَنَسُوهُ: they let their own deeds drop from hold though God has counted them (أَحْصَىٰهُ) — held content lapses. Residue present.
نَسُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ: they let God drop from active regard — culpable retention-lapse. Residue present.
فَأَنسَىٰهُمْ أَنفُسَهُمْ: causative — He made their own selves drop from their active regard as requital.
وَنَسُوا۟ حَظًّا مِّمَّا ذُكِّرُوا۟: they let a portion of what they were reminded of drop from hold. Residue present.
فَنَسُوا۟ حَظًّا مِّمَّا ذُكِّرُوا۟: same — a held portion of the reminder drops from active regard. Residue present.
وَتَنسَوْنَ مَا تُشْرِكُونَ: in distress you let your associated partners drop from active regard. Residue present.
فَلَمَّا نَسُوا۟ مَا ذُكِّرُوا۟ بِهِ: they let the reminder they held drop from active regard. Residue present.
يُنسِيَنَّكَ ٱلشَّيْطَٰنُ: causative — should Satan make (the injunction) drop from your hold. Residue present.
فَلَمَّا نَسُوا۟ مَا ذُكِّرُوا۟ بِهِ: they let the held reminder drop from active regard. Residue present.
فَٱلْيَوْمَ نَنسَىٰهُمْ: divine requital — We drop them from beneficent regard, mirrored by كَمَا نَسُوا۟. Bridged.
كَمَا نَسُوا۟ لِقَآءَ يَوْمِهِمْ: their own retention-lapse of the held meeting — referent of the mirror. Residue present.
ٱلَّذِينَ نَسُوهُ مِن قَبْلُ: those who earlier let it (the Book's fulfillment) drop from active regard. Residue present.
فَلَا تَنسَىٰ: the given recitation (سَنُقْرِئُكَ) guaranteed not to drop from hold — retention-lapse negated. Residue present.
نَسُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ: they let God drop from active regard — culpable retention-lapse. Residue present.
فَنَسِيَهُمْ: divine requital — He drops them from beneficent regard, mirroring نَسُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ. Bridged.
